title: harnesspm.json
description: Project configuration for harnesspm, the harness package manager. Every field is optional.

exclude.description: Packages or unit IDs to drop, such as "@tenphi/glaze" or "tasty:rules/legacy".

replace.description: Unit ID → path of a project file that takes its place.

patch.description: Rule ID → path of a patch that changes some of its sections.

trust.description: Packages whose executable units may run: true follows upgrades, "pin" needs an approval for each new version.

telemetry.description: Events about how agents and people use the harness, sent to the project's handler. Off when missing. See spec chapter 14.

events.description: The event types to send, or "all" (the default). "read", "skill" and "session" come from harnesspm's own agent hooks.

send.description: The handler: a command that gets each event as JSON on stdin, run from the project root, or { "file": "<path>" }, which appends one JSON line per event. It gets events only as a person's sync recorded it in harnesspm.lock.json.

file.description: Path relative to the project root.
